responsibility: Declares the SysV4/ELF-specific option table entries used by PowerPC rs6000 subtargets. It binds options such as -mcall-, -msdata=, -mtls-size=, endianness, strict alignment, relocatable code, EABI, secure PLT selection, and related SysV4 ABI controls to backend variables and masks, complementing the generic powerpcspe.opt option set with ELF-subtarget configuration switches.
same_name_distinction: This is the SysV4/ELF option-definition file, declaring switches such as -mcall-, -msdata=, -mtls-size=, endianness, relocatable, EABI, and secure-PLT controls. Unlike sysv4.h, it does not contain the ELF ABI policy, specs, or option-override logic that applies those settings.
